item.title: Bulletin updated at 20:35 HKT 23/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Kajiki will move in the general direction of the seas south of Hainan Island today and tomorrow. There will be occasional squally showers and thunderstorms, as well as swells over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong. With Kajiki moving inland over Indo-China and dissipating, showers will ease off gradually over the coast of Guangdong early next week. The broad area of low pressure now over the seas east of the Philippines is expected to move to the central part of the South China Sea gradually midweek next week. Under its influence, the weather will be unsettled over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
